title: Implement Message-ID duplicate detection at POST
description:
Before signing or storing, check the Message-ID→CID map for the incoming article's Message-ID. If already known, return 441 (duplicate). This prevents re-signing and re-storing articles that arrived via transit peering. Artifact: integrated into reader/src/post/pipeline.rs.

Acceptance:
- Duplicate Message-ID → 441 with 'duplicate' in response text
- Check happens before any signing or IPFS operation
- Unit test: first POST of an article succeeds; second POST with same Message-ID returns 441
